annotation.title_clean: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2.0 (NAIS 2.0): AI for the Public Good, For Singapore and the World
annotation.title_en: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2.0 (NAIS 2.0): AI for the Public Good, For Singapore and the World
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government of the Republic of Singapore (Smart Nation Group)
annotation.summary_en: Singapore's second National AI Strategy (December 2023) sets the vision of AI for the Public Good. It organises actions across industry, government, talent, capabilities, compute, data, research and a trusted environment, emphasising investment, workforce development and governance tools like AI Verify. Embodied AI is barely mentioned.
key_provisions_or_claims: Vision: AI for the Public Good, for Singapore and the World
Three shifts: opportunity to necessity, local to global, projects to systems
Boost AI practitioner pool to 15,000 via training and open talent policy
Builds on Model AI Governance Framework and AI Verify testing toolkit
Fosters a trusted environment protecting users while enabling innovation
